title: [Feature][PD] Adapt Mooncake V2 Mamba transfers to PCP head sharding
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Adapt Mooncake Connector V2 to Mamba state sharding across PCP × TP workers, using TP-major/PCP-minor worker ranks for shard selection and reusing the existing Conv/SSM transfer slicing.

Require PCP=1 or TP=1 until the backend supports joint PCP/TP sharding. Add coverage for worker-rank mapping and state transfer addresses across PCP/TP layouts.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No.

### How was this patch tested?

By CI.
